feeds.title: What to fetch
feeds.description: `open` = new public comment calls (意見募集案件, drafts open for comment). `results` = published results (結果公示案件: submitted comment counts, final rules, government responses).

enumTitles: Open calls for comment (意見募集)

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Limit to e-Gov policy categories. When set, the per-category feeds are read (they reach further back than the all-items feed). Leave empty for all categories.

enum: 国民生活の安全・安心の確保

keywords.title: Title keywords (any)
keywords.description: Keep only items whose title contains at least one of these strings, e.g. `AI`, `個人情報`, `電波`, `金融商品取引法`.

ministries.title: Ministries / agencies (any)
ministries.description: Keep only items from these organisations (partial match), e.g. `総務省`, `金融庁`, `経済産業省`, `個人情報保護委員会`.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch detail pages
fetchDetails.description: Open each item page to add the case number, legal basis, procedure type, reception start, revision status and links to all documents (PDF drafts, guidelines, results). One extra request per item.

onlyNew.title: Monitoring mode: only new items
onlyNew.description: Remember items already returned (named key-value store) and output only new ones. Schedule daily or a few times per day. Items whose detail page failed are retried next run.

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Separate name for the "already seen" list, so schedules with different filters do not interfere. Letters, digits, - and _ only. Do not run two schedules with the same key at the same time.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Maximum number of items to output.

maxDetailRequests.title: Max detail page requests per run
maxDetailRequests.description: Upper limit on detail pages fetched in one run (each page may be retried up to 3 times on temporary errors). In monitoring mode, items left over are processed by the next run.

requestIntervalMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
requestIntervalMs.description: Pause between requests to e-Gov. Minimum 1000 ms.
